summary: Iteration 3 — verified the FIX for /api/stripe/checkout-status. All 38 backend tests pass (16 email/stripe + 22 xss0r regression). The endpoint no longer returns 500 when the Emergent ephemeral Stripe proxy can't retrieve a session — it now catches stripe.error.InvalidRequestError and returns the cached payment_transactions snapshot with HTTP 200 and a 'cached: true' field. Other StripeError types now return 502 with sanitized 'Payment provider unavailable' message (no leaked Stripe request ids). 404 still returned for unknown session_ids not in payment_transactions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1203 lines — still recommend splitting auth, billing/stripe, admin, scans/builds into separate FastAPI routers (>700 line guideline). Carry-over from iter 2.

Webhook signature verification remains bypassed when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset — fine for dev; ensure production deploy has the secret set and consider failing closed when env=='production' and secret is empty. Carry-over from iter 2.

Cached-fallback path now exposes 'cached: true' to client — good. Consider also surfacing 'cached_at' timestamp so the UI can decide when to stop polling and show a 'session expired' banner if cached for >N seconds.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed test users created and cleaned up via existing fixtures. No persistent state changes. Demo user license remained 'pro' after webhook idempotency test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend tests green. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. test_email_stripe.py now has 3 dedicated tests for /api/stripe/checkout-status: pro session, enterprise session, and 404-for-unknown-sid. Both pro+enterprise paths exercise the InvalidRequestError -> cached fallback branch (verified via backend.err.log: 'not retrievable, returning cached'). The 'cached: true' marker is asserted when present. server.py:899-913 is the relevant fix block.
rca of the issue: FIX VERIFIED. Root cause was: stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id) raises InvalidRequestError because the Emergent Stripe test proxy is ephemeral (sessions not persisted across the brief checkout->status round-trip). Original handler caught only stripe.error.StripeError and re-raised as HTTPException(500). Fix at /app/backend/server.py:899-913 now catches stripe.error.InvalidRequestError specifically and returns {'payment_status': txn.get('payment_status','unpaid'), 'status': txn.get('status','open'), 'amount_total': txn.get('amount_cents',0), 'currency': txn.get('currency','usd'), 'cached': True} with HTTP 200. A separate broader StripeError handler returns 502 'Payment provider unavailable' (sanitized — no internal request id leaked). Reproduction: POST /api/stripe/checkout {plan:'pro'|'enterprise'} -> session_id -> GET /api/stripe/checkout-status/{session_id} -> 200 with cached:true (confirmed in backend logs).
